pages.text: $(l)Immersive Engineering diesel is a good power option$()—it's surprisingly light on performance: even at 36x torcherino it was only ~0.5 mspt.
$(l)Use the Biome Hatch with Meteoric Beefalo efficiently$(): place one Beefalo per required biome instead of switching biomes repeatedly for each recipe.
$(l)For rapid iron smelting$(), run a Smeltery with a Tinkers I/O Fuel Input Machine: it melts Blocks of Iron in ~1 second, and fluid lasers extract fast enough to keep up.
$(l)Uranium ore is best sourced from uranium bees$()—MA seeds yield ingots, not ore.
